KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Define, track, and report key business and team performance metrics.

 - Build and maintain internal performance dashboards and reports.

 - Create clear visualizations and data displays for leadership and teams.

 - Strong stakeholder management and problem-solving skills.

 - Ability to work independently and take ownership of metrics and reporting.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager (SPM) who can own products end-to-end — from identifying customer and business problems to defining the product strategy, shipping high-quality experiences, and measuring outcomes.

The ideal candidate should be a strong product thinker, execution leader, customer advocate, and stakeholder manager, with hands-on experience in building and scaling digital products. Experience in FinTech, lending, payments, Internet, or e-commerce is highly preferred.

Key Responsibilities

* Own the product vision, roadmap, prioritisation, and execution for one or more product areas.

* Drive products/features through the complete lifecycle — discovery → definition → development → launch → measurement → iteration.
* Lead feature launches and product releases, ensuring strong execution, adoption, and measurable business impact.
* Work closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Analytics, Business, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Marketing, and other cross-functional teams.
* Manage multiple high-priority and concurrent product initiatives in an Agile environment.
* Own customer-facing experiences and continuously improve UX, conversion, engagement, and customer satisfaction.
* Use data, experimentation, customer insights, and qualitative feedback to make evidence-based product decisions.
* Identify product opportunities through customer research, market trends, competitive analysis, and business performance.

* Proactively identify product risks, dependencies, bottlenecks, and execution challenges and drive them to closure.
* Mentor and guide product team members and contribute to building a high-performing product culture.

Required Qualifications & Experience

* Engineering background — B.E./B.Tech or equivalent technical education preferred.
* Strong product management experience, with demonstrated ownership of products from concept to launch and scale.
* Prior experience in FinTech / Lending / Payments / Financial Services is strongly preferred.
* Experience in Internet, e-commerce, consumer technology, or other high-scale digital businesses is also highly relevant.
* Experience building and managing customer-facing digital products/assets.
Proven track record of shipping products and features at scale, not just managing requirements.
* Strong experience in stakeholder management, including working with senior leadership and cross-functional teams.
* Prior experience in team management / mentoring / product team leadership.
* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and experience operating in fast-paced product environments.
* Ability to independently manage multiple mainstream/high-impact projects simultaneously, while maintaining prioritisation and execution discipline.
* Strong understanding of product analytics, experimentation, funnels, conversion metrics, and customer behaviour.
* Hands-on experience using AI/GenAI in product development or business use cases.
* Candidates should be comfortable discussing practical AI applications; practical AI use cases will be evaluated during the interview.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex problems and communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.

items.description:
About Us
Paytm is India’s leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. A pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution, Paytm builds technology that enables small businesses and consumers to participate in the digital economy. Our mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them into the mainstream economy through technology.

About the Role
We are looking for a strategic, customer-focused and data-driven Product Manager to own and scale products and experiences for Paytm’s offline merchant ecosystem.
The role will be responsible for defining product strategy, identifying customer and business opportunities, building product roadmaps and driving end-to-end execution across the product lifecycle. The candidate will work closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Business, Operations and other cross-functional teams to build products that improve merchant adoption, engagement, productivity and retention.
The ideal candidate will combine strong product thinking with analytical ability, customer empathy and execution excellence. This is a high-ownership role that requires the ability to translate complex business problems and merchant needs into simple, scalable and impactful product solutions.

Key Responsibilities
*Own the end-to-end product lifecycle across discovery, ideation, prioritization, development, launch and continuous iteration.
*Define product vision, strategy and roadmap for key merchant-facing products and journeys within the Offline Merchants / EDC ecosystem.
*Identify merchant pain points and business opportunities through customer research, product analytics, market insights and stakeholder inputs.
*Translate customer and business requirements into clear product requirements, user stories, product specifications and actionable roadmaps.
*Work closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Business, Operations and other teams to drive timely and high-quality product execution.
*Define and track key product metrics across acquisition, activation, engagement, usage, retention and monetization, and use data to drive product decisions.
*Drive experimentation, A/B testing and rapid iteration to validate product hypotheses and improve user experience and business outcomes.
*Identify opportunities across merchant journeys and service products to improve adoption, engagement, transaction frequency and overall merchant experience.
*Leverage analytics, segmentation, personalization and AI/Agentic capabilities to improve product experiences, automate workflows and create scalable solutions for merchants.
*Develop a deep understanding of merchant behavior, competitive offerings and industry trends to identify new product opportunities.
*Collaborate with business and operations teams to ensure successful product launches, adoption and scalability across the merchant ecosystem.
*Establish strong product processes, documentation and prioritization frameworks to ensure effective execution across multiple stakeholders.
*Own product charters based on evolving business priorities and identify new avenues for sustainable product and business growth.
*Lead and mentor product managers / team members where applicable, fostering strong product thinking, ownership and execution excellence.

What We’re Looking For
*Strong academic pedigree; Tier-1 institute preferred.
*Relevant experience in Product Management, preferably with Tier-1 product, consumer internet, fintech or high-scale technology companies.
*Proven experience in owning products end-to-end, from product discovery and strategy to launch, adoption and iteration.
*Strong understanding of product development lifecycle, product strategy, roadmap planning and prioritization.
*Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data and customer insights into product decisions.
*Hands-on experience with product analytics, experimentation, A/B testing, user segmentation and product metrics.

items.title: Technical Lead Manager
items.description:
Read this first
You're probably already doing most of this job without the title. People bring designs to you before they build, your review is the one that catches things, and when something breaks late at night you're on the thread whether or not you're on-call. Juniors ask you about their careers even though nobody made that your job.
What we'd like to add is a team that's actually yours, a real say in who joins it, and the authority to decide how your part of the system gets built.
TLM is the step before Engineering Manager and we'd rather say that plainly than pretend otherwise. In 12 to 18 months you're either running a bigger team as an EM or you've worked out that you'd rather go deep, in which case Staff and Principal are open. Either way you won't be stuck.
